system.description:
A disorienting cloud of angry, biting locusts fills an area around you out to near.

The cloud moves with you as you move. You are not affected by it.

Creatures in the area of effect take [[/r 1d10]] damage per round at the start of their turn. They must pass a Constitution check equal to your last spellcasting check or be unable to move on their turn.
